column1: # Benchmark routes for scripts/bench.py: name, DM_KEYS (seconds from host start), measuring window start and length (s), description.
# Written on update 1.8.0 on an M2 Pro (2026-11-11), from a save made by one start to the main menu (<build>/run/save). There the title takes A from about 20 s on, and
# eight presses go through the main menu, Single Player, Grand Prix, the character, the kart, the Mushroom Cup, 50cc and "Start Grand Prix?"; the course's fly-over and the
# countdown take about 30 s more (no cup movie on this path), and a 50cc race driven by holding A lasts over three minutes. Check a run's screenshots when the Mac or the
# save changes: `--shots 38,66,100,150` shows the title, the fly-over and two moments of the race.
